book.name: 1 Thessalonians
book.title: 1 THESSALONIANS PAUL AN FEF AINAUIN IGAYAM THESSALONICA YANGAN AURIS

content: Wonbotitiwagim Bada Enat aurin
Wei taitai tutuai, wei men arimon aurim fef wangayam wankasonem ra a wera meyan on atonio osi bobo sinmamatar aurin on.
Yabin omi toum on wosagob tiwag Bada an Ra on arimon orot bainauotin ba fom innat.

Sabu dura sinbikakafun si’nau, ‘@147’Yawas engon tutufin on obinai wat yen ato ot on men tabeber on,‘@148’ ato ra kaita yababan komasin bag on arimon inmatar osi auris! On bobo arimon baisafur ba inmatar, ato jever koun egigiai toub aurin usibaban eboai ba, ato sabu arimon men sinayai sinyawas on.
Baise taitai tutuai, omi on men woumanai womama on, ato Ra on men arimon orot bainauotin ba inisafurem mom on.
Omi sabu engon tutufin iyabon ratafin ebinoanai on, ra on omi ebinoanim. Ot on men fom o wouman ebinoanai on.
On mes ot on men tanembubur mes, ato sabu fani sefofour ba, baise ot on matat sineit a ati bainonot on totorinai wat tanbinonot.
Awa efofom on sabu senbubur; awa efofom on sabu sareu wawanis setotom sebikokok.

Baise ot on ra ebinoanai, ato ot ati bainonot on totorinai wat tanbinonot. Ot on God tanbitutumai a tanbinuaboai on dogarat an beyan mes ba tanitakwakwarit, a dura bagai tanmomousin God inbiyawasit aurin on unit koas ba tanyagai inrufafaret.
God on men irubinet ato inimakiet tanikokosarit on, baise ati Bada Iesu Kerisoai on God ebiyawasit on tanboai mes,
Iesu Keriso on ot aurit irabob onai ot On mat on tatikaita mat tatama mes, On innanat on mamaba ot on yawasit tamama o tarabob on arimon engon fofonin wat.
On mes atonio duraiai on tuturam wonkufaiwaris bonen a wonibaisis bonen, ato ari omi wofofour ba.
Ekesim ami Dura a ami Baikakaiu
Wei taitai tutuai, wei wabifefeyanim ato sabu omi sanamui sebobo on wonkakafes tiwag, osi on Keriso an yawasai sebonanawaiim a sebitotorim.
Omi osi sabu on gagaminai bag wonkakafes a woninuabois, yabin osi ato bobo sebobo on fasinai. Omi toum sanamui on engon tufai wat wonama.
Wei taitai tutuai, wei wabifefeyanim, dura wawaninai sabu nokonokois on wonawures, sabu sebeber on wonkufaiwaris, sabu samisamis on wonibaisis, sabu engon auris on yaterabobai wat auris wonafour.

Omi wonkaifarem tiwag, men iyafan tani turan aurin bobo komasin ifour ato angaramin aurin bobo komasin inafour men, baise wonafourtobon ra fufur on bobo obis wat auris on wonafour bonen a sabu engon tutufin auris wonafour.
Omi ra fufur woniyasisir,
omi ra fufur wonbayoi,
omi bobo aifan magis magis aurim sinmamatar on ra fufur God wonbikakaiwai. Atonio osi bobo nanaba on God egogoi omi ami yawasai wonafour Keriso Iesu mat wonikaita wonama.
Omi men Ayu Kakafotin an bobo wonsibunin mes;
God an dura ato ayuai ibo egat aubairuruotis sebikakafun on men woniyamai on dura yabis wagas wat sinmatar ato wonisisiweiai mes.
Dura engon tutufin on wonrutobonen woneit dura bag o men dura bag: bobo obin wat on nana wonbokikin,
ato bobo komasis ta ta on men amosi wonar mes.

Wei God aurin wababayoi On tuf ebitet on infourim eta au engonai on ami yawas tutufinai On aurin wonkutetim kakafotim wonmatar a usim engon tutufin ebotan—ayubim, ayum a usim on inbotanen ato ati Bada Iesu Keriso innanat men on, omi men arimon ubar tani wonboai on.
God On iyorem on bobo arimon inafour mes, yabin On an aumatan on nana ebotan.
Wei taitai tutuai, wei mat auri on God aurin wababayoi.
Omi sabu baitutumotis engon wonbikakaiwis on taitu an yawasai nan rerebam wonyayanen.
Yau on Bada an faiwarai abifefeyanim, atonio fef on sabu baitutumotis engon tutufin auris woniyab sintatam.
Yau ababayoi ati Bada Iesu Keriso an kaber on omi bisimui inama.
